plugins.name: agent-autonomous-developer
plugins.description: Takes one work package (a ticket or an epic with all its children) from a prepared worktree to a pull request with a GREEN CI pipeline, for projects in any language (stack auto-detected). One headless skill — process-developer — backed by six subagents (context-extractor, planner, plan-critic, developer, test-critic, reviewer) with isolated critics, three-round caps and machine-readable progress events on the ticket. Never asks a human. Drives the agent-project-issues MCP.

plugins.name: agent-worktree
plugins.description: MCP server for git worktree lifecycle management. Create/list/remove worktrees with branch handling, run per-project setup scripts on creation, and detect uncommitted changes before destructive operations.

plugins.name: agent-project-issues
plugins.description: MCP server for GitHub/GitLab issue management. Read/create/update tickets and add comments with automatic safety markers (ai-generated / ai-modified labels, #ai-generated comment prefix). Per-project permissions; falls back to read-only auto-discovery from the git remote when no config is present.

plugins.name: agent-ticket-orchestrator
plugins.description: Board-driven ecosystem orchestrator: bundles and clarifies Backlog tickets into released work packages (gatekeeper), then runs every Todo package unattended through agent-autonomous-developer to a merged, CI-green PR, moving board columns as the only status signal (run).

plugins.name: agent-autonomous-prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Takes one work package whose change is prose that a model executes (skills, agent definitions, prompts, tool documentation, AGENTS.md) from a prepared worktree to a pull request with a GREEN CI pipeline. One headless skill — process-prompt-engineer — backed by five subagents (prose-context-extractor, prose-planner, scenario-critic, prose-writer, prose-reviewer). Evidence that fits prose instead of text-pin tests: lint, step replay on a rebuilt real case, isolated blind tests, baseline vs. after. Speaks the adev:event contract of agent-autonomous-developer. Never asks a human. Drives the agent-project-issues MCP.

plugins.name: agent-comfy
plugins.description: MCP server for driving ComfyUI - submit workflows, manage the prompt queue, and fetch generated images

plugins.name: agent-serena-wrapper
plugins.description: Pairs the external Serena MCP server with a skill so Claude works with code through token-efficient semantic operations instead of reading whole files.

plugins.name: agent-blender-wrapper
plugins.description: Pairs the external BlenderMCP server with a skill so Claude can drive Blender - inspecting scenes, creating and modifying objects, applying materials, and sourcing assets - through structured MCP operations instead of blind Python scripting.
